name: Hoimar/Planet-Generator
description: A procedural planet generator Godot addon using layered noise with dynamic terrain LOD and chunk streaming, written in GDScript. Drop-in plugin for Godot 3 projects needing spherical world generation.
score_rationale: The primary Godot-native procedural planet plugin with LOD support and clean addon architecture.
summary: Godot addon for procedural planet generation with LOD and dynamic chunk streaming.
